ambiguity_flags.note: Category A governance-sensitive. 'truth_store' as a replacement for LAYER_2 introduces semantic collision with the existing canonical concept 'Snapshot Truth' (concept ID: SNAPSHOT_TRUTH). Layer-2 is defined in current documentation as 'operational at snapshot boundary' — a boundary concept. 'truth_store' implies a storage-layer identity rather than an architectural boundary, weakening snapshot boundary semantics. Additionally, code-level identifiers such as 'layer2_truth.db' may share the 'truth' stem, creating cross-domain ambiguity between architectural labels and code identifiers. This is a blocking ambiguity under the fail-closed principle (CLAUDE.md Section 7).

Category B and Category D governance-sensitive. 'decision_layer' as a replacement for LAYER_3 is semantically adjacent to the explicitly discouraged variant 'decision engine' for LAYER_3. Layer-3 spans multiple distinct planned components (Feature Builder, Index Suite, Regime Gate, Supervisor Engine, Decision Engine, DecisionPacket generator) — collapsing the layer label to 'decision_layer' narrows the architectural concept in a way that may misrepresent the scope of planned Phase C/D build-out. It also creates adjacency overlap with the canonical 'DecisionPacket' concept (DECISION_PACKET), risking conflation between the layer label and the output artifact name. This is a blocking ambiguity: it would alter how phase-gate claims are classified and how strong-claim discipline (CLAUDE.md Section 10) is enforced.
